title: Standard-basis normalisation: Σ_j α(e∘j)² = n!·|α|_E²
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let α be an n-covector on ℝ^P (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n, a continuous alternating n-linear form on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)), and let e_i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i (i ∈ Fin P) be the standard orthonormal basis of ℝ^P. Then Σ_{j : Fin n → Fin P} α(e_{j(0)}, …, e_{j(n−1)})² = n!·|α|_E², where |α|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), ∑ j : Fin n → Fin P, (α (fun k => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (j k))) ^ 2 = (n.factorial : ℝ) * covectorEuclideanNorm α ^ 2
